name: Katagiri Aika
source:
Yuusuke's younger sister. 
Aika is a student at the girls' school where Hidetaka works. She has a crush on Hidetaka and occasionally makes subtle advances to him but is repeatedly turned down.

She has her own ending in Reminiscence Collector's Edition.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/レミニセンス_(ゲーム)]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]]
